title: ajustmarket
description: Market Plugin for servers, allowing players to buy and sell items with an in-game currency.
body:
# > 📖 What does this plugin add?
> 
> This Plugin add's market inspired by polish server anarchia.gg's market
> 
## > ✅ Features:
> - command for listing items (/wystaw)¹
> - market (/rynek)²
> - plugin reload (/smarket reload)³
> 
## > 🕶️ How to use commands?
> 
> -¹ /wystaw <quanity> <price>
  > 
> -² /rynek
> 
> -³ /smarket reload or /stasiulekmarket reload
> 
# > 📥 Installation Guide
> ajustmarket is for many server loaders like paper spigot bukkit and etc.
> ajustmarket also needs ajustapi that is downloadable when you click on versions tab and then version you wanna download

# IMPORTANT!
The only official places to download this plugin are:

Modrinth
and one another site not russian!

If you download it from any other website, it is an unauthorized mirror.
